design.name: proportional_gem
design.why: controls are matched per GEM file, so the sample keeps each file's share of every target; pi = min(1, 40/n) for every cell of a target; k is a tranche size: a later window (40, k1) adds cells and keeps these
design.not_an_owner_decision: the cap is a proposal: the original parquet files stay on the host, and window can be widened without resampling

filters.targeted: one target per cell as published in gene_target

output_contract.shards: contracts.py version 1, one shard per GEM file, X = integer counts on the native token axis (gene_metadata), var with official_index/mapping/symbol_duplicate_rank
extra_obs: orion_<every scalar column of the parquet>
output_contract.identity: cell_key = study|GEM file|row<ordinal>: the row ordinal in a file pinned by its sha256; no barcode column is assumed
output_contract.layout: <out>/<unit>/<GEM file>.h5ad, receipts, manifest.json, complete.json last, verify_manifest.json for verify_drive.py

validators: meta: rows, pass-filter cells, non-targeting cells and targets per line equal the pass of 26/09 or the job stops
sample: parquet with sidecar sha256 written before any count is read; shards carry that sha256
shards: size and LFS sha256 of every file; rows read equal the cells chosen (target by target); contract validation and re-read of every shard; cells in shards equal the sample
after the job: verify_drive.py on another Colab runtime, then publish_kaggle.py and the Kaggle-side sha256

resources_estimate.meta: a few MB per file by ranges (unmeasured)
resources_estimate.shards: 126.3 GB downloaded one file at a time (about 0.5 GB on disk at once), about 29% of the cells kept: an estimate from medians of 164 and 211 cells per target, to be measured

proposed_role: training inside the frozen folds of groups HCT116 and HEK293T (already bench groups); never a reserve; adoption is R-LEAD's decision
